title: Conjunction circuit
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $C_n$ be the directed acyclic Boolean circuit obtained by emitting an AND tree on the input vertices $0,1,0,dots,n-1$; its output is the vertex returned by that tree construction.
caveat: The statement depends on the omitted definition of the tree-emission procedure, so its exact behavior, including the case $n=0$, cannot be fully described from the supplied definitions.
